description: Query a domain's A or NS records on about 30 well-known public resolvers (all queried from httpfy.io's server; anycast resolvers answer from their nearest site) and report each resolver's answer, NXDOMAIN, NODATA or failure, to see whether a DNS change has propagated. CDN and GeoDNS names can legitimately differ between resolvers.
name: dns_propagation_check
title: DNS propagation check
